## Proposed Scene or Engine Enhancement
Describe the proposed procedural animation, mathematical/physical model, or rasterizer capability.

## Mathematical / Shader Formulation
If proposing a new scene, outline the geometry, particle kinematics, or shader equations involved.

## Interactive Climax Trigger
Which hotkey (`[A]`–`[Z]`) triggers the scene's climax state, and what visual phenomenon does it produce?

## Performance Impact
Confirm that the feature maintains 60–120 FPS in pure Python stdlib without external runtime dependencies.
